sources.citation: docs/victron-gx-modbus-tcp-register-list.xlsx — Victron ModbusTCP Register list, from Victron's own repository https://github.com/victronenergy/dbus_modbustcp. Sheets: Field list (1010 rows − 2 header = 1008 registers),

The repository's live attributes.csv currently carries 1194 data rows against the committed sheet's 1008. The provenance is real but this is lineage, not a byte-identical file — the vendor's map has moved on.
https://github.com/victronenergy/dbus-flashmq — vendor's own repository. README documents the ports, the N/ R/ W/ topic scheme, keepalive and authentication.
https://github.com/victronenergy/dbus-mqtt — vendor's own repository, records the deprecation at Venus OS v3.20.
https://www.victronenergy.com/media/pg/Cerbo_GX/en/ — Cerbo GX manual MQTT section: local broker on 8883 (SSL) and 1883 (plain), depending on the security profile.
